mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the chest and lower body was most worthwhile: the diaphragm and separate routes between regions made the overall arrangement easier to picture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lymph network felt less engaging because it mostly aligned a junction that was already built.

surprise.text: The joined trunk made it clearer that the food pipe, nerves and blood vessels cross between regions by their own routes.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary, though the later combinations were the only offered actions, so they felt more like assembly than decisions.

continue.text: Probably not immediately. The completed body is a satisfying endpoint, but the final sequence had few meaningful choices.
